values.value: == VALIDATION RULE XML FORMAT == Validation Rules are EMBEDDED inside the CustomObject XML, not separate files. File path: objects/ObjectName__c.object metadataType: CustomObject memberName: ObjectName__c <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <CustomObject xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata"> <label>Existing Object Label</label> <pluralLabel>Existing Plural Label</pluralLabel> <nameField> <label>Existing Name Field Label</label> <type>Text</type> </nameField> <deploymentStatus>Deployed</deploymentStatus> <sharingModel>ReadWrite</sharingModel> <validationRules> <fullName>RuleName</fullName> <active>true</active> <description>Optional description</description> <errorConditionFormula>Price__c <= 0</errorConditionFormula> <errorDisplayField>Price__c</errorDisplayField> <errorMessage>Price must be greater than zero.</errorMessage> </validationRules> </CustomObject> RULES: - Element order MUST be: fullName, active, description (optional), errorConditionFormula, errorDisplayField (optional), errorMessage - description is optional — omit entirely if not provided - errorDisplayField is optional — omit entirely if not provided - active defaults to true if not specified - ALWAYS XML-escape formula characters: < → < > → > & → & - Formula syntax: use AND(), OR(), NOT() as functions never as keywords - Formula syntax: use ISBLANK(field) never = "" - Formula syntax: for picklist fields use ISPICKVAL(Field__c, "Value") never = or != - Formula syntax: TODAY() returns a Date, NOW() returns a Date/Time — they are NOT interchangeable, and a field's actual type can differ from what its label/API name implies or from what an earlier ticket originally requested. Before writing ANY comparison (<, >, <=, >=) between a field and TODAY()/NOW(), you MUST check that field's real type in the METADATA section of this prompt (which reflects the field's actual current type in the org) — never assume the type from the field name or the ticket wording. - If the field's real type is Date: compare with TODAY() (e.g. Reserved_Date__c < TODAY()). - If the field's real type is Date/Time: either compare with NOW() directly (e.g. Reserved_Date__c < NOW()), or convert it to a Date first with DATEVALUE() and compare with TODAY() (e.g. DATEVALUE(Reserved_Date__c) < TODAY()). - Mismatching these (e.g. a Date/Time field compared with TODAY(), or a Date field compared with NOW()) fails to deploy with "Incorrect parameter type for operator... Expected Date/Time, received Date" (or the reverse). - Multiple validation rules on same object = ONE object XML file with multiple <validationRules> blocks - When adding a validation rule to existing object: use sharingModel from org state - For DELETING a validation rule, use destructiveFiles with type ValidationRule and member = ObjectName__c.RuleName (e.g. Car__c.PriceMustBePositive) - CRITICAL: When updating/creating a rule on an existing object, preserve ALL other existing validation rules from org state in the same XML file — do not drop them
